title: Bounded non-UTF8 proof-regeneration diagnostic on frozen phase2/phase3 Lean theorems
frozen_utc: 2026-09-07T08:31Z (tasks/manifest.json written before any model call; first model call 08:34:21Z)
purpose: Measure whether a bounded, fresh-context model can regenerate proofs of already-checked theorems tied to byte conservation, partial-error behaviour and shell short-circuit/status semantics, and whether reviewed reusable helper lemmas change the outcome. Unpowered diagnostic; not a benchmark, not a model comparison, not novelty evidence.

shell_status.facet: shell short-circuit and exit-status composition: an accepted query proved on the abstract fragment transfers to every terminating concrete execution across `;`, `&&`, `||`

byte_relay.facet: byte-bearing relay: the pointer-memory evaluator refines the list model under the whole shell fragment; delivered bytes, unread stream and status observable, pending hidden at exit
imports_unchanged: PointerRelay (run_detailed_eq available; statement given in prompt)
ShellObservation (command_refines available; statement given in prompt)

partial_error.facet: partial-error behaviour: write failure (status 2) leaves a nonempty pending suffix and delivered bytes strictly below consumed bytes
partial_error.note: execute_contract and all earlier lemmas stay in both conditions because later definitions and downstream modules depend on them; the base condition therefore removes only the designated reusable byte-conservation contract.

freeze.what_is_frozen: imports, definitions, helper lemma set per condition, target theorem statement (byte-for-byte), closing namespace; recorded in tasks/manifest.json with SHA-256 per template and per source file
freeze.what_the_model_may_produce: the proof after the final `:=` only (tactic block or term)
freeze.leak_control: model runs with all tools disabled, no session, no context files; prompt contains the frozen template and statement-only signatures of the imported declarations named above; original proofs are held out (tasks/*/original_proof.txt is used only as the checker's positive control)
freeze.known_limitation: the model's training data is unknown; the phase2/phase3 sources are in a private repository, but memorisation cannot be excluded by this protocol

conditions.helper: reviewed reusable helper lemmas that precede the target in the same file are present with proofs
conditions.base: those helper lemmas are deleted (statement and proof); imports and definitions identical
same_across_conditions: 120 s wall limit per model call

design.order: interleaved (attempt 1 of every cell, then attempt 2), one Pi process at a time

gates: frozen identity (template + all baseline sources byte-identical to the repository)
lake build +Module:olean in a private copy, LEAN_NUM_THREADS=1, 120 s, 3 GiB address space, build output must not mention sorry
#check @theorem output equals the type recorded from the unchanged repository build (tasks/*/expected_check.txt)
checker.compiler_lock: ~/.cache/bash-spec-pilot/phase3-compiler.lock (shared flock; added 08:36Z after orchestrator correction — attempts 1-10 were checked before the lock was added; all accepted submissions were re-checked under the lock, receipts recheck-*)
controls: original proof accepted in every helper cell (3/3)
original proof rejected in every base cell (3/3): it depends on the removed helper

accounting.first_pass_vs_assisted: all 12 attempts are first-pass; no assisted round was run
accounting.interventions: none on any submission; harness re-indents lines by two spaces only; a harness bug (missing -s16384 for lake env lean) was fixed before attempts began (controls control-* vs control2-*)
accounting.orchestrator_vs_agent_vs_human: task selection, freeze, checker and prompt authored by the Claude evaluation worker; model attempts by grok-4.6 via Pi; orchestrator supplied the coordination correction on the compiler lock; no human edits

non_claims: no C, libc, OS or CompCert/VST evidence
no Bash parser or State Calculus evidence
no model-superiority or novelty claim; n=2 per cell
